column1: # Nepali seed dictionary: word <TAB> frequency proxy.
# Small hand list so the dictionary layer works out of the box.
# Replace / extend with a corpus-derived list via `cargo run -p xlit-dict --bin build`.
# Three groups below: (1) core Nepali vocabulary, (2) common English loanwords,
# (3) proper nouns (places, countries, people) — all in their accepted
# Devanagari spelling. Groups 2 and 3 matter because the rule engine
# transliterates letter-by-letter and cannot know that "hello" is written हेलो
# (not हेल्लो) or that Nepali spells the name रवीन्द्रनाथ (not the Hindi-style
# रवींद्रनाथ). The dictionary's exact/fuzzy pass over these entries, together
# with the engine's de-geminated and nasal-conjunct variants, is what fixes them.
# --- proper nouns: places, countries, people (accepted Nepali spelling) ---
# Nepali orthography keeps the nasal conjunct (गञ्ज, लङ्का) where Hindi writes
